The divergence is positional / sorting dynamics, not directed migration: neither substrate moves type A far up the gradient.

nodes.label: SUPERSEDED READINGS, kept for provenance. (a) Spatial same 1.000 / cross 0.08...
nodes.statement: SUPERSEDED READINGS, kept for provenance. (a) Spatial same 1.000 / cross 0.083 (median drift ~8.5 um) was an artifact of mechanically deterministic replicates and non-moving vertex cells; the 2026-10-28 reading was same 0.608 / cross 0.472, Delta +0.135, CI [+0.071, +0.210]. (b) The positive-control "vertex climbs the gradient to y~17.9, CPM ~10.7" mechanism (cross 0.20 vs same 1.00, diff +0.80) came from the old uncalibrated linear ActiveMigration mapping. (c) Earlier candidate substrate signals (raw IoU cross 0.165 vs CPM 0.249 / vertex 0.212; centroid 6.1 vs 5.4 um) came from deterministic or over-mobile (folding) vertex replicates.

nodes.label: No substrate matches the CPM on every axis. Vertex matches per-cell trajector...
nodes.statement: No substrate matches the CPM on every axis. Vertex matches per-cell trajectories (displacement 2.93, below the CPM-self null 3.77) and contact churn (0.445 vs 0.414) but under-fluctuates (MSD 2.7x null) and mis-sorts (8.5x null); center-based now moves and interacts (displacement 9.96, MSD 124.1) with contact topology (0.458) and sorting (0.021) close to the CPM, but is over-mobile (MSD 38x null) and diverges most on infection-front speed (4.4x null). Munk values are from the 2026-11 rerun (seeded per-instance motility RNG; not bit-reproducible vs the earlier stored run).
